channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about George Hill | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about George Hill from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on George Hill
item.description:
Darko Rajaković to Kawhi Leonard:

“I want to tell you a funny story. I was working with San Antonio. I was coaching in Europe and I was their international scout. So the day you got drafted, I was with San Antonio in the draft room. I was part of the trade. I was like seven people. There was Lindsey, RC, coach Pop, I was there with like a couple of scouts. And when we traded George Hill and we got your draft rights, I was there when you got drafted.”

Kawhi Leonard on George Hill, Sep 17, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on George Hill
item.description:
“Quite frankly, he came back in in that New York game and I was like, 'That's young George Hill. There's some miles left.' He really helped us in that game. What came out of the exit meeting is that he loves it here, and that means a lot to me. He loves playing. He loves competing. There's an overwhelming sense that he really helped our point guards where he came in.”

Kevin Pritchard on George Hill, Apr 11, 2023. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Bennedict Mathurin on James Johnson, George Hill
item.description:
Dustin Dopirak:Bennedict Mathurin:

“Having James Johnson and George Hill on the team was one of the biggest blessings in my career.”

Bennedict Mathurin on James Johnson, George Hill, Apr 10, 2023. Source: Twitter @DustinDopirak.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on George Hill
item.description:
Eric Nehm:Bucks coach Mike Budenholzer, on George Hill:

“Similar (to Brook). He's close. He had a good day yesterday. I think he's come through it well. So, I would say they're both doing really well and they're both close.”

Mike Budenholzer on George Hill, Mar 12, 2022. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on George Hill
item.description:
#Bucks HC Mike Budenholzer:

“It's a little harder starting with what most would consider our two point guards together in Jrue & George and have been playing Justin some. There's been a little bit of a pinch there.”

Mike Budenholzer on George Hill, Nov 10, 2021. Source: Twitter @JimOwczarski.

item.title: Daryl Morey on George Hill
item.description:
Morey said,

“We really like what George brought. He’s the kind of guy you want on a team trying to win the championship. He’s gone very deep in the playoffs many times.”

Daryl Morey on George Hill, Jun 23, 2021. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Daryl Morey on George Hill
item.description:
Michael Scotto:Daryl Morey on George Hill’s non-guaranteed deal next season:

“None of those determinations have been made. I will say that we really like what George brought. He’s the kind of guy you want on a team trying to win the championship. He’s gone very deep in the playoffs many times.”

Daryl Morey on George Hill, Jun 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Mark Daigneault on George Hill
item.description:
Mark Daigneault on how close Hill is to returning:

“I wouldn’t say day to day. There is a rehab process with the kind of surgery he had after the cast comes off.”

Mark Daigneault on George Hill, Mar 22, 2021. Source: Twitter @BrandonRahbar.

item.title: Robin Lopez on Wesley Matthews, George Hill, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
Fred Katz:Robin Lopez:

“I’m really gonna miss playing with Wesley and Giannis and Khris Middleton and PC and George and so many players, but I’m not gonna miss Brook. I can tell you that.”

Robin Lopez on Wesley Matthews, George Hill, Khris Middleton, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Nov 24, 2020. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Jose Manuel Calderon on George Hill
item.description:
“At that moment, that was our chance. We go to the free-throw line with George Hill, one of the best free-throw shooters ever and he makes the first one. I'm thinking at least we've got the tie. With the second one, everything happened so quick.”

Jose Manuel Calderon on George Hill, Oct 2, 2020. Source: Bleacher Report.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on George Hill, Sterling Brown
item.description:
Bucks@Giannis Antetokounmpo says,

“Life tells you to do something and you do. I saw George and Sterling, and George decided not to play the game. George didn’t put any pressure on me. Sterling wasn’t going to play... As a leader and a teammate wasn’t going to leave them behind.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on George Hill, Sterling Brown, Aug 29, 2020. Source: Twitter @MarcJSpears.

item.title: Eric Bledsoe on George Hill
item.description:
“I’m always proud of George. Coming in, picking up the slack. He came in, without Malcolm (Brogdon) playing and played a hell of a game. He’s been a vet in this league. He knows what it takes. He’s been to the championship; he’s been to the Eastern Conference Finals. It’s no surprise what he's doing.”

Eric Bledsoe on George Hill, May 4, 2019. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Larry Drew on George Hill
item.description:
head coach Larry Drew said following Friday's practice.

“I think everybody wants to start, but everybody's production as a starter is not very good. As a coach, what I try to do, I try to look at what a guy does as a starter versus what he does off the bench. Certainly with G Hill out, Collin has definitely stepped up to the plate and made his presence felt and has made a major impact to what we've been doing.”

Larry Drew on George Hill, Nov 16, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on George Hill, LeBron James
item.description:
#Cavs Tyronn Lue on LeBron James' usage rate being lowest all postseason last night:

“We put in a few new sets last night & it gave us more movement. Bron doesn’t want to move too much, so we had to make JR and G Hill do all the moving and Bron just hold the ball.(laughs)”

Tyronn Lue on George Hill, LeBron James, May 20, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChrisFedor.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on George Hill
item.description:
head coach Tyronn Lue said following Monday's 128-93 win.

“When he got hurt in the Indiana series, it really hurt us. When he's on the floor, then LeBron doesn't have to over-handle. With G-Hill out there, when he's feeling 100 percent, that really helps us out offensively. That allows JR (Smith) and Kyle (Korver) to get to their spots and knock down open shots.”

Tyronn Lue on George Hill, May 8, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: Tristan Thompson on George Hill
item.description:
“G-Hill not playing in the first half coming in the third quarter and giving us that spark at the point guard position with him and LeBron running the 13 action, it was huge for us,”

Tristan Thompson on George Hill, Apr 29, 2018. Source: Cleveland Plain Dealer.

item.title: De'Aaron Fox on George Hill
item.description:
When De’Aaron Fox might be starstruck for a second, or just too new to the NBA to know the tendencies of his opponent, Hill is around to help.

“I’ll be watching someone who I grew up watching, and (Hill will) say something, and I’ll be like, ‘Wow, I didn’t notice that,’”

De'Aaron Fox on George Hill, Jan 21, 2018. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Bogdan Bogdanovic on George Hill
item.description:
“Speed is the biggest difference, but the defense is more physical, and then there is the three-second rule. George, I don’t even need to ask. I just look at him and he is like, ‘Oh, you need to do this or do that,’ in words I understand. I learn many, many things from him.”

Bogdan Bogdanovic on George Hill, Oct 6, 2017. Source: Sacramento Bee.

item.title: Bill Neff on Dennis Lindsey, Gordon Hayward, George Hill, Quin Snyder
item.description:
Neff told The Tribune on Wednesday.

“One, George likes it in Utah. Two, George has a close relationship with Gordon Hayward [both are Indianapolis natives]. Three, [Jazz general manager] Dennis Lindsey was largely responsible for bringing George to San Antonio. George has worked with [Jazz coach] Quin Snyder. This is one of the teams George has always wanted to play for.”

Bill Neff on Dennis Lindsey, Gordon Hayward, George Hill, Quin Snyder, Jun 22, 2016. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.

item.title: Lance Stephenson on Paul George, George Hill
item.description:
Scott Agness:Lance Stephenson on his postgame visit with Paul George, George Hill:

“How much we miss each other. Talking about the old times real quick.”

Lance Stephenson on Paul George, George Hill, Jan 27, 2016. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Lavoy Allen on George Hill
item.description:
Never taking himself too seriously, Lavoy Allen had some great one-liners Tuesday after re-signing with the Pacers bit.ly/1LUEW7W For ex.:Allen on the Hickory uniforms,

“I don’t know if I loved the uniforms or maybe George Hill just makes them look good bc of the hair”

Lavoy Allen on George Hill, Jul 29, 2015. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Rodney Stuckey on George Hill
item.description:
Stuckey:

“If they want me 2 go in there & back George Hill up I’ll do that. I just can’t wait 2 get out on the ct & play w/ all these guys”

Rodney Stuckey on George Hill, Jul 21, 2015. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: Quinn Cook on Tony Parker, George Hill
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Quinn Cook:

“I would rather go into the league and learn. I want to learn from vets. I want to learn from Tony Parker… the George Hills (of NBA).”

Quinn Cook on Tony Parker, George Hill, May 15, 2015. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.

item.title: RC Buford on George Hill
item.description:
Buford said with a laugh.

“Tim, Tony and Manu, those guys had a really strong alignment with George. They'd been through a lot together, and there was concern for them, not only that they were losing a great friend but also a great teammate. So the trust that that group allowed us to make that move — because we don't do that without including them. That trust was vital to them saying, 'OK, we don't like this, but we'll frickin' see.'”

RC Buford on George Hill, Jun 14, 2014. Source: USA Today Sports.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on George Hill
item.description:
Kevin Pritchard on possibly upgrading the point guard spot before trade deadline:

“We feel great about George Hill. … For us George Hill fits us perfectly because he’s a great catch-and-shoot player and he gets us in our offense, and Lance (Stephenson) and Paul (George) are such good playmakers.”

Kevin Pritchard on George Hill, Feb 5, 2014. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Manu Ginobili on George Hill
item.description:
Manu Ginobili:

“When he came I got really angry because I enjoyed playing with George Hill. I was frustrated that they had traded him for a rookie. But I didn't know who he was. Ever since his first year, despite the lockout, he showed some things. But in the second half of last season, it was crazy. You had to take your hat off. The guy can play, he deserves to have the ball in his hand and earned our respect. If you ask him, even Pop's going to say he was surprised.”

Manu Ginobili on George Hill, Oct 31, 2013. Source: Ole.

item.title: Paul George on George Hill
item.description:
Start with lots of George Hill, who did his best work of the night in that crucial third quarter stretch.

“I tell George all the time, he’s just as good as any point guard in this playoff run right now,”

Paul George on George Hill, May 15, 2013. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Frank Vogel on Darren Collison, George Hill
item.description:
Frank Vogel on the point guard situation between Darren Collison and George Hill (if Hill re-signs):

“I would hope that (Hill) stays at the level that he played at during the end of this year and that he would be the starting point guard. But I could definitely see a situation where Darren, one of the most driven players I've ever been around, comes back and outplays George. He's that driven and that's a real possibility. I'm hoping that we have them both back; that they both strive to get better in the offseason and I have a very difficult decision to make next year. That's what I hope.”

Frank Vogel on Darren Collison, George Hill, May 30, 2012. Source: Indianapolis Star.
